title: Dromana Community Market
summary: Community market at Dromana Community Park on the last Saturday of the month. Mix of produce, craft, plants and local makers.
recurrenceNote: Monthly – Last Saturday of every month; check the organiser for the next date
verificationStatus: 26 September date and 8:00am–1:30pm hours confirmed by organiser policies
nearbyAttractions: Dromana Beach; Dromana Indoor Market; Peninsula Hot Springs
editorVerdict: Dromana's last-Saturday market is a community Saturday, not a destination. Useful if you're already heading to the beach.
editorNote:
The Dromana Community Market runs at Dromana Community Park on the last Saturday of each month. The organiser's policies list market hours as 8:00am–1:30pm at 359B Point Nepean Road. Expect produce, craft, plants and local makers.

Go if you're combining it with a Dromana foreshore morning or a trip up Arthurs Seat. Check the organiser's website for any changes before setting off.
